run_evaluation_benchmark: run a benchmark evaluation using launch_evals with a model path and config file
run_distributed_evals: run distributed evaluation jobs across SLURM nodes using launch_evals with distributed mode
run_local_evals: run evaluation jobs locally via subprocess using launch_evals with distributed set to false
run_cli_benchmark: run the benchmark CLI with key=value arguments like model_loader_kwargs.pretrained_weights
review_launch_evals: review the launch_evals function that merges configs and launches evaluation jobs
